title: prefill-decode: chunked speculative prefill + stage-overlap + kernel scheduler + KV-cache optimizations
author: Asha Patel
description: Context: Serving pipeline for prefill (key/value cache fill) and decode has historically been serialized: prefill -> decode. For long prefixes and heterogeneous batch sizes this created head-of-line latency and suboptimal GPU utilization. This PR implements a set of coordinated improvements: 1) chunked prefill (split long prefills into smaller chunks and allow decode to start on already-prefilled prefixes), 2) speculative prefill (issue prefill chunks in parallel when safe based on model/kernal constraints), 3) stage overlap scheduling (overlap prefill and decode stages where dependencies allow), and 4) kernel-scheduler + KV-cache enhancements (better kernel selection heuristics, aggressive KV-cache sharding and async eviction) to reduce contention and memory pressure. Motivation: reduce end-to-end latency for mixed workloads (short chat turns and long-context completions), improve GPU utilization for bursty traffic, and lower per-token compute cost by allowing earlier decoding and better batching. Summary of changes: - Introduce ChunkedPrefillManager that slices long prefill requests into configurable chunk_size tokens and tracks chunk-level dependencies. - Add SpeculativePrefillController which conservatively issues speculative prefill chunks when model-compatibility heuristics indicate no correctness risk. - Implement StageOverlapScheduler that dynamically schedules prefill/decode tasks to overlap compute kernels while preserving KV-cache consistency. - Kernel scheduler heuristics updated to prefer fused attention kernels for short-decoder steps, and to select lower-memory kernels when KV-cache sharding is active. - KV cache: per-shard async eviction + finer-grained locking to remove serialization on cache updates during overlap. - Add continuous-batching hooks so in-flight prefill chunks can be batched with small decode steps to improve throughput. Benchmarks: internal perf suite (n=1000 mixed requests) shows median latency improvement of 14% for end-to-end generate for mixed workloads, p95 improved 18%, throughput up to +20% on A100 pools in our dedicated environment, and 9% lower average GPU SM utilization variance. Safety: correctness tests added to ensure deterministic outputs when speculative prefill is disabled; speculative mode gated behind config and opt-in flag per-deployment. Rollout plan: feature-flagged rollout to dedicated and hosted canaries, observe regression alarms for quality diffs and latency, then broaden to ~25% traffic for 48h before full rollout. Checklist: - [x] Unit tests for ChunkedPrefillManager - [x] Integration tests for overlap scheduling - [x] Perf benchmarks added - [x] Documentation and config knobs - [x] Feature flag and canary rollout notes

review_comments: Miguel Torres: Great work — can you add a test that validates correctness when speculative prefill drops a chunk?
Asha Patel: Added an integration test that simulates a dropped speculative chunk and verifies fallback to non-speculative path (see tests/perf).
Samir Gupta: Kernel selection heuristics look good; suggest adding telemetry dimensions to count times we pick low-memory kernel vs fused kernel.
Asha Patel: Added kernel_selection.metrics.{kernel_choice,reason} and a dashboard in docs/performance.
Lina Rodriguez: KV shard eviction looks racy under heavy eviction pressure on small GPUs — please ensure backpressure.
Asha Patel: Adjusted eviction to use a bounded async queue and emit backpressure metric; documented behavior and added guard rails.
Samir Gupta: CI flaky on perf workflow. Miguel, can we ignore perf flakiness for merge?
Miguel Torres: We'll gate merge on functional CI passing; perf reruns will be tracked separately.

perf_summary: Mixed workload perf (n=1000): median latency -14%, p95 -18%, throughput +20% on A100 dedicated pool; GPU memory transient spikes reduced by ~12% due to KV sharding; continuous-batching increased effective batching for small decodes by 1.8x.
testing_notes: Added unit and integration tests; new perf harness test added under tests/perf; local repro scripts in examples/prefill to validate chunking behavior; regression tests measure bit-for-bit equality when speculative prefill disabled.
rollout: Feature-flagged rollout: opt-in in dedicated canaries; 48h 25% traffic ramp after green canaries; automatic rollback if quality drift > 1% or latency regresses > 10% for 1 hour.

release_notes: Runtime: Prefill/Decode pipeline optimizations (chunked prefill, speculative prefill, stage overlap) — improves latency and throughput for mixed workloads. Feature gated; enable via runtime.prefill.chunking and runtime.prefill.speculative flags.
notes_for_reviewers: Pay special attention to the speculative heuristics and the eviction backpressure behavior. The feature is gated and off by default for hosted until canary validation completes.
